identifiedBy.fact: climber.org driving page names Lewis Camp the most efficient start for Angora and Coyote (author's judgement, not called 'standard'); Lloyd Meadow described as the lower, snow-free-sooner alternative

otherFacts.value: about 7 one way from Lloyd Meadows pullout to summit

notes: MODERATE, not clear-cut. Lewis Camp: climber.org 1996/89, themtsarecalling.com/angora (30.8 mi, 9300 ft day, Lewis Camp), climber.org driving page recommends it. Lloyd Meadows/Jerkey pullout (USFS Jerkey TH 36.167611,-118.485535; blog coords 36.1672,-118.4856 match): peaksforfreaks 2016, wacziarg 2023. 3 reports + recommendation vs 2; nobody calls Lloyd the usual. SummitPost route page titled 'Jerkey Meadow and Lewis Camp' not opened (403). Both starts share the same Little Kern trail beyond Jerky Meadow. Review before locking; Jerkey TH is the runner-up.

Starts seen: Onion Valley (Kearsarge Pass / University+Forester Pass): climber.org 2008/1646 (east ridge), climber.org 1999/420 (entered at Kearsarge Pass). Symmes Creek via Shepherd Pass: scaruffi.com/travel/caltech.html (one-day, 56 km). Shepherd Pass TH (USFS 36.726905,-118.278912) is the same road as Symmes Creek. Wikipedia names no trailhead; climber.org SPS page and SummitPost (403) give none. Evidence 2 vs 1, no authority: stuck. Leads: USFS Onion Valley Campground 36.772538,-118.341244.
